title: Life expectancy gained since 2001, by income group

source.name: The Association Between Income and Life Expectancy in the United States, 2001-2014 (Chetty et al., JAMA 2016)
source.publisher: JAMA (Journal of the American Medical Association)

notes: Approximate figures from the study: the richest fifth gained roughly 2.3 years of life expectancy over the period; the poorest fifth gained roughly 0.3 years.
